data.rationale: Internal host SRV-DB-02 initiated a high-volume SFTP transfer to 203.0.113.199 and transfer.example-cloudshare.net, both flagged as malicious with exfiltration tags in threat intelligence. The activity involves the svc_backup account mapping to MITRE T1048, and while a related benign backup spike exists, the destination's threat score of 90 overrides this contextual noise.
suggested_actions: Immediately isolate or block outbound traffic from SRV-DB-02 to 203.0.113.199 and transfer.example-cloudshare.net to stop potential data loss.
Verify with the backup team if svc_backup is authorized to use sftp://transfer.example-cloudshare.net/upload and confirm if this specific transfer was scheduled.
Inspect proxy or firewall logs for SRV-DB-02 to determine the exact volume and file names transferred during this session.
Review authentication logs for svc_backup on SRV-DB-02 to ensure the account has not been compromised or misused outside of normal backup windows.
